card.name: Linking words in environmental toxicology text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, on, to, a, commas) right after chemical or pollutant terms in environmental contamination text, where an ecosystem or aquatic-life word may come next.

modes.label: Prepositions after pollutants
modes.description: Words like on, to, of following toxic chemicals or research on their effects on wildlife.
modes.example: It is highly toxic<< to>> fish and shell fish.
